liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **09 - Evil Urges**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [11]
- **18 - Off the Record**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [11]
- **59 - Gideon**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [11]
- **04 - I'm Amazed**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [11]
- **30 - Highly Suspicious**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [11]
- **12 - What a Wonderful Man**: back after 31 archived shows (589 days); mythic rare: 2 archived performances [11]
- **29 - Touch Me I'm Going to Scream Part 1**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [11]
- **42 - Sec Walkin**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [11]

## The recordings

- **mmj2008-06-20.mk41.kc5.cmc6.744t.flacf16** (recommended): source not stated; 27 songs; 158 min; rated 5/5 by 4 [1]. Said about its sound: The recording is described as one of the finest Jacket recordings the listener has heard; The sound was spine-tingling from the third balcony, and the recording captures the crowd's spontaneous applause [6][10]
- **mmj2008-06-20.dpa4023.flac16**: source not stated; 27 songs; 161 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [2]
- **mmj2008-06-20.dpa4023.flac24**: source not stated; 27 songs; 161 min [3]

## Around the show

- A microphone stand blocked the listener's view of Jim James throughout the performance [4]
- Jim James wore a cape, and Pat Hallahan played drums to an electric atmosphere [5]
- The crowd was notably chatty, prompting the listener to urge them to be quiet [9]
- This specific recording is considered the best among Radio City Music Hall uploads posted by June 27 [7]

## Tapers and lineage

- **mmj2008-06-20.mk41.kc5.cmc6.744t.flacf16**: taped by baustin; transferred by baustin; source: Schoeps mk41 {NOS}/kc5/cmc6~>Sound Devices 744t {24/48} [1]. Also: Processed in Wavelab 5.0a with UV22HR, then encoded to FLAC level 6 from a 2nd Mezzanine seat [1]
- **mmj2008-06-20.dpa4023.flac16**: taped by Scott Brown; source: DPA (B&K) 4023s > Lunatec V3 > Audio Magic Illusion QL XLRs > Mytek Stereo 192 ADC > Audio Magic Illusion QL Digital XLR > Sound Devices 722 [2]. Also: Recorded in ORTF format at 11 feet high, section 400, row ZZ, seat 405 [2]
- **mmj2008-06-20.dpa4023.flac24**: taped by Scott Brown; source: DPA (B&K) 4023s > Lunatec V3 > Audio Magic Illusion QL XLRs > Mytek Stereo 192 ADC @24 bit, 96khz > Audio Magic Illusion QL Digital XLR > Sound Devices 722 [3]. Also: Original 24-bit, 96kHz recording captured in ORTF format from section 400, row ZZ, seat 405 [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Guy: [My Morning Jacket NY Concert Poster by Guy Burwell (SOLD OUT) | Poster Cabaret](https://postercabaret.com/gallery/sold-out/my-morning-jacket-ny-concert-poster-by-guy-burwell-sold-out/) [12]
